parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A primary button of the mouse made of ABS plastic, typically located on the top surface.
parts.Functional_description: Used for primary clicking actions such as selecting or confirming commands.
parts.Movement_description: Moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A secondary button of the mouse made of ABS plastic, located adjacent to the primary button.
parts.Functional_description: Used for secondary clicking actions such as opening context menus or alternate functions.
parts.Movement_description: Moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A side button made of ABS plastic, often used for additional programmable functions.
parts.Functional_description: Provides extra input options such as forward or backward navigation.
parts.Movement_description: Moves slightly inward when pressed and returns via a small spring mechanism.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: Another side or top button made of ABS plastic, used for customizable input.
parts.Functional_description: Can be programmed for specific functions like DPI adjustment or macro execution.
parts.Movement_description: Moves slightly inward when pressed and returns via a small spring mechanism.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: An auxiliary button made of ABS plastic, typically used for special functions.
parts.Functional_description: May control lighting, sensitivity, or other device-specific features.
parts.Movement_description: Moves vertically or inward when pressed and returns via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A programmable button made of ABS plastic, often used for gaming or productivity shortcuts.
parts.Functional_description: Allows user-defined actions or macros for enhanced control.
parts.Movement_description: Moves slightly inward when pressed and returns via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Wheel
parts.Basic_description: A scroll wheel made of rubber-coated plastic, located between the main buttons.
parts.Functional_description: Used for scrolling through documents or web pages and can also act as a middle button when pressed.
parts.Movement_description: Rotates around its axis for scrolling and can be pressed vertically for clicking.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main body of the mouse made of ABS plastic, housing internal components and providing ergonomic support.
parts.Functional_description: Supports all other parts, provides structure, and ensures comfortable hand placement.
parts.Movement_description: Remains stationary relative to the internal components; moves as a whole when the mouse is moved across a surface.
